name: Git Diff
author: CliDeck
description: View the git diff of a session's working folder without leaving CliDeck

settings.label: Default Scope
settings.description: Which scope the diff opens on

settings.label: Base Branch
settings.description: Branch to compare against in base scope. Empty means detect origin/HEAD, then main, then master

settings.label: Syntax Highlighting
settings.description: Colour code in the diff using highlight.js

settings.label: Context Lines
settings.description: Unchanged lines shown around each change

settings.label: Auto-refresh Seconds
settings.description: How often to re-run git while the diff is open. 0 disables auto-refresh

settings.label: Max Changed Lines
settings.description: Diffs larger than this show a placeholder instead of rendering

settings.label: Open Key
settings.description: Key to open and close the diff (e.g. F9, Ctrl+Shift+D)
